title: Distributional Point Values for Borel and Symmetric Borel Derivatives
summary: Borel and symmetric Borel derivatives are generalized derivatives defined through local averages of difference quotients. Distributional point values, in the sense of Łojasiewicz and its symmetric variants, are a classical way of describing the local value of a distribution. This paper connects these two ideas. Writing $T_f$ for the regular distribution generated by $f$, we prove that finite first and second symmetric Borel derivatives give symmetric distributional point values of $T_f'$ and $T_f''$, respectively.
